meta.description: Expanded draft rewrite of generic reaction templates using R-group abstractions and curated row-based example assignments.
notes: Source metadata references were removed from the catalog content.
Example assignments were re-curated to better match the CSV transformations.
Only rows with reasonably confident parent-reaction assignments are mapped in this draft.

templates.generic_notes: Simple SN2 halide exchange.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Backside iodide attack on the alkyl carbon.
Leaving group departs as halide.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Single-step SN2 displacement.

templates.generic_notes: β-Elimination of a sulfonate ester.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Base removes the β-hydrogen.
C-H electrons form the alkene.
Sulfonate leaves as the π bond forms.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Concerted E2 elimination.

templates.label_exact: Alkyl halide E2 elimination to styrene-type alkene
templates.generic_notes: Base-promoted β-elimination of an alkyl halide.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Base abstracts the β-hydrogen.
Electrons form the alkene.
Halide leaves in the concerted step.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Concerted E2 elimination.

templates.generic_notes: Overall saponification/deacylation of an acetate ester.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Hydroxide attacks the ester carbonyl.
Collapse of the tetrahedral intermediate restores the carbonyl.
Alkoxide departure gives the hydrolysis products.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Compressed one-step hydrolysis template matching the benchmark row.

templates.generic_notes: Organomagnesium reagent opens an epoxide to form a new C-C bond.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Carbanion equivalent attacks the epoxide carbon.
Ring opens to give the alkoxide.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Epoxide opening with carbon-carbon bond formation.

templates.generic_notes: Carbon-carbon bond formation by SN2 alkylation of an enolate.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Enolate carbon attacks the electrophilic methylene.
Bromide leaves during SN2 substitution.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Single-step enolate alkylation.

templates.generic_notes: Thiohydroximate-O-sulfonate precursor undergoes desulfonylation to give isothiocyanate. The starting material is better represented as R-N=C(S-)(O-SO3-) where R-CH2 bears the nitrogen.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The O-sulfonyl group departs from the precursor.
Electron reorganization gives the isothiocyanate cumulene.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Compressed rearrangement/elimination template.

templates._correction: CHEM-001: SM connectivity corrected; R-CH2 bonded to N (not S) in precursor.

templates.generic_notes: Benzyl thioether formation by SN2.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Thiolate attacks the benzyl carbon.
Chloride leaves as the thioether forms.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Single-step benzyl substitution.

templates.label_exact: Allyl ether formation from heteroaryl phenoxide
templates.generic_notes: Williamson allylation of a phenoxide/heteroaryl oxide.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Phenoxide attacks the allylic carbon.
Bromide leaves in the SN2 step.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Single-step allyl ether formation.

templates.generic_notes: Carbon-carbon bond formation by SN2 displacement of an allylic sulfonate.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Acetylide attacks the allylic electrophile.
Sulfonate leaves during substitution.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Single-step alkynyl alkylation.

templates.label_exact: Hofmann elimination of quaternary ammonium hydroxide
templates.generic_notes: β-Elimination from a quaternary ammonium hydroxide.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Hydroxide removes the β-hydrogen.
Electrons form the alkene.
Neutral tertiary amine leaves.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Concerted Hofmann elimination.

templates.generic_notes: Methyl ester formation using diazomethane.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The acid-derived carboxylate attacks the methylating carbon of diazomethane.
Proton transfer activates diazomethane toward methyl transfer.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Ion-pair/methylating intermediate forms.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Methyl transfer gives the ester.
Nitrogen departs as dinitrogen.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Ester forms with extrusion of nitrogen.

templates.generic_notes: O-methylation of a phenol using diazomethane.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The phenolic oxygen attacks the methylating carbon.
Proton transfer activates diazomethane and generates the phenoxide-like nucleophile.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: O-methylation intermediate forms.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Methyl transfer gives the anisole product.
Dinitrogen is expelled.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Methoxy product forms with nitrogen loss.

templates.label_exact: Williamson ether synthesis from phenol and alkyl iodide
templates.generic_notes: Phenol deprotonation followed by alkylation.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Base deprotonates the phenol to give phenoxide.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Phenoxide nucleophile is generated.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Phenoxide attacks the alkyl iodide.
Iodide leaves during SN2 substitution.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Ether bond forms in the substitution step.

templates.generic_notes: Base-promoted cyclization of a halohydrin/haloalcohol to a five-membered ether. HO-(CH2)4-X contains O + 4 CH2 groups = 5-membered ring (THF). For 6-membered (THP) cyclization, HO-(CH2)5-X would be needed.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Base deprotonates the alcohol to give the alkoxide.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Alkoxide for cyclization is generated.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Alkoxide performs intramolecular SN2 ring closure.
Leaving group departs to complete ring formation.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Five-membered ether ring forms.

templates.label_exact: SN1 hydrolysis of tertiary benzylic chloride
templates.generic_notes: Tertiary benzylic chloride undergoes solvolysis.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Ionization gives a resonance-stabilized carbocation.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Rate-determining ionization step.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Water traps the carbocation.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Oxonium intermediate forms.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Deprotonation gives the neutral alcohol.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Product alcohol is released.

templates.label_exact: Glycidyl ether formation from phenol and epichlorohydrin
templates.generic_notes: Phenoxide substitution on epichlorohydrin followed by epoxide formation.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Base generates the aryloxide.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Aryloxide nucleophile forms.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Aryloxide opens the epoxide.
Ring opening gives a chlorohydrin alkoxide/alcohol.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: β-Chlorohydrin ether intermediate forms.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Base generates the alkoxide on the chlorohydrin.
Intramolecular SN2 closes the epoxide.
Chloride departs during ring closure.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Glycidyl ether product is formed.

templates.generic_notes: Alcohol acylation by an acid chloride.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Alcohol attacks the acid chloride carbonyl.
π Electrons shift to oxygen to give the tetrahedral intermediate.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Tetrahedral intermediate forms after nucleophilic addition.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Intermediate collapses to re-form the carbonyl.
Chloride departs as the leaving group.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Acyl substitution yields protonated ester product.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Base removes the extra proton to neutralize the ester.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Base scavenges HCl / deprotonates the ester.

templates.generic_notes: Elimination-addition via benzyne.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Strong base removes the ortho proton adjacent to the leaving group.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Arylic carbanion precursor to benzyne is generated.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Carbanion electrons form the strained benzyne π bond.
Chloride is expelled as benzyne forms.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Benzyne intermediate is produced.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Amide adds to the benzyne triple bond surrogate.
The second π component shifts to the neighboring carbon, giving a carbanion.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Addition step gives a σ-complex carbanion.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Protonation restores aromaticity and gives the aniline.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Protonation completes the elimination-addition sequence.

templates.generic_notes: Electrophilic aromatic substitution nitration.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Nitric acid is protonated by sulfuric acid.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Activation of nitric acid in the mixed acid medium.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Water departs to generate the nitronium ion.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Nitronium electrophile forms.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The aromatic ring attacks the nitronium ion, forming the Wheland intermediate.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Electrophilic aromatic attack step.

electron_pushes_generic.description: A base removes the proton from the σ-complex.
Aromaticity is restored as the π bond reforms.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Deprotonation restores aromaticity and yields the nitroarene.

templates.label_exact: Boron enolate aldol addition to aldehyde
templates.generic_notes: Boron enolate adds to an aldehyde and is then protonated during workup.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The enolate carbon adds to the aldehyde carbonyl carbon.
The carbonyl pi bond shifts to oxygen.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: C-C bond formation gives a boron-bound aldolate.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The alkoxide remains coordinated to boron as the aldol adduct organizes.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The addition product is held as a boron alkoxide.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Aqueous workup breaks the boron-oxygen linkage.
The alkoxide is protonated to the alcohol.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Workup releases the beta-hydroxy carbonyl product.

templates.label_exact: Amide formation from acid chloride and amine
templates.generic_notes: Nucleophilic acyl substitution of an acid chloride by an amine.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The amine attacks the acid chloride carbonyl.
The carbonyl pi bond shifts to oxygen.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Amine addition forms the tetrahedral intermediate.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The tetrahedral intermediate collapses to re-form the carbonyl.
Chloride leaves during collapse.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Collapse expels chloride and gives the acylated ammonium species.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Base removes the extra proton from nitrogen.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Base neutralizes the amide product.

templates.generic_notes: An alcohol attacks acetic anhydride to form an acetate ester.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The alcohol oxygen attacks one anhydride carbonyl.
The carbonyl pi bond shifts to oxygen.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Alcohol addition gives a tetrahedral intermediate.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Collapse re-forms the carbonyl.
Acetate leaves as the departing group.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Collapse produces the acetate ester.

electron_pushes_generic.description: A base removes the proton from the product oxonium.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Deprotonation gives the neutral ester.

templates.label_exact: Trityl ether formation for alcohol protection
templates.generic_notes: A trityl cation equivalent is trapped by an alcohol to give a trityl ether protecting group.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The benzylic C-Cl bond ionizes to give a resonance-stabilized trityl cation.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Ionization produces the trityl electrophile.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The alcohol oxygen attacks the trityl cation.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The protected-ether framework forms as an oxonium ion.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Base removes the extra proton from oxygen.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Deprotonation gives the neutral trityl ether.

templates.generic_notes: Alcohol oxygen attacks sulfur of a sulfonyl chloride to form a sulfonate leaving group.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The alcohol oxygen attacks sulfur.
Sulfur expands coordination during attack.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Attack at sulfur forms the sulfonyl transfer intermediate.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Chloride departs as the sulfonate bond set collapses.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Chloride leaves to give the alkoxysulfonium-like product.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Base removes the proton from oxygen.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Deprotonation gives the neutral sulfonate ester.

templates.generic_notes: E1 dehydration of a tertiary alcohol under acidic conditions.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The alcohol is protonated to make water a leaving group.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Protonation activates the alcohol.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Water leaves to form a carbocation.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Ionization produces the carbocation intermediate.

electron_pushes_generic.description: A base removes a beta proton.
The electrons form the alkene.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Loss of a beta proton gives the alkene.

templates.generic_notes: Acid-activated epoxide opening by water followed by deprotonation.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The epoxide oxygen is protonated.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Protonation activates the epoxide toward ring opening.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Water attacks one epoxide carbon.
The epoxide ring opens as the C-O bond breaks.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Water opens the ring to give a protonated diol.

electron_pushes_generic.description: A base removes the extra proton from oxygen.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Deprotonation yields the neutral diol.

templates.generic_notes: Base generates the enol/enolate, which is trapped at oxygen by an acetylating reagent.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Base removes the alpha proton.
The electrons generate the enolate resonance pair.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The ketone is converted to its enolate equivalent.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The oxygen attacks the acetyl electrophile.
The acyl carbonyl pi bond shifts to oxygen.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The enolate oxygen is acylated.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Collapse re-forms the acetyl carbonyl.
The leaving group departs to give the enol acetate.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Collapse furnishes the enol acetate.

templates.label_exact: Silyl enol ether formation from ketone
templates.generic_notes: An enolate formed from a ketone is trapped with a silyl chloride at oxygen.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Strong base removes the alpha proton.
The resulting electrons generate the enolate.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The ketone is converted to its enolate.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The enolate oxygen attacks silicon.
Chloride leaves from silicon.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: SN2 at silicon: enolate oxygen displaces chloride to give the silyl enol ether directly.

templates._correction: CHEM-002: Removed redundant step 3 (silyloxonium_intermediate -> silyl enol ether is not a real step; step 2 already gives the product). Updated suitable_step_count to 2.

templates.generic_notes: Base forms a nitronate that adds to a ketone and is then protonated.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Base removes the acidic proton alpha to the nitro group.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The nitro compound is converted to a nitronate nucleophile.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The nitronate carbon attacks the carbonyl carbon.
The carbonyl pi bond shifts to oxygen.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: C-C bond formation gives the beta-nitro alkoxide.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Protonation yields the alcohol.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Workup furnishes the beta-nitro alcohol.

templates.label_exact: Aldol addition of lithium enolate to aldehyde
templates.generic_notes: A preformed lithium enolate adds to an aldehyde, then is protonated.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The enolate carbon attacks the aldehyde carbonyl carbon.
The carbonyl pi bond shifts to oxygen.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The carbon-carbon bond is formed.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The alkoxide remains associated with lithium.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The product exists as a metal alkoxide before workup.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Protonation converts the alkoxide to the alcohol.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Aqueous workup yields the aldol addition product.

templates.label_exact: Michael addition of enolate to enone
templates.generic_notes: A soft enolate adds at the beta carbon of an enone and the resulting enolate is protonated.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The nucleophile attacks the beta carbon in a 1,4-addition.
The conjugated pi system shifts to the carbonyl oxygen.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Conjugate addition forms a new carbon-carbon bond.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The adduct is represented as the resulting enolate.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The product exists as an enolate after conjugate addition.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Protonation furnishes the neutral Michael adduct.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Workup yields the neutral conjugate-addition product.

templates.generic_notes: Base generates an alpha-halo ester enolate, which adds to a carbonyl and cyclizes to an epoxide.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Base removes the alpha proton adjacent to the ester and halide.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The alpha-halo ester is converted to its enolate.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The enolate attacks the aldehyde or ketone.
The carbonyl pi bond shifts to oxygen.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Addition gives a beta-halo alkoxide.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Intramolecular substitution closes the epoxide ring.
Halide leaves during ring closure.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Ring closure furnishes the glycidic ester.

templates.generic_notes: An ester enolate attacks another ester and collapses with alkoxide loss to give a Claisen product.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Base removes the alpha proton from the donor ester.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The donor ester is converted to its enolate.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The enolate attacks the ester electrophile.
The ester carbonyl pi bond shifts to oxygen.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Attack forms the tetrahedral intermediate.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Collapse re-forms the carbonyl.
Alkoxide leaves from the tetrahedral intermediate.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Collapse gives the Claisen condensation product, often as its enolate.

templates.label_exact: Alpha-sulfide formation from enolate and disulfide
templates.generic_notes: An enolate attacks one sulfur atom of a disulfide to install a thio substituent.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Base generates the carbonyl enolate.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The carbonyl compound is deprotonated to the enolate.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The enolate carbon attacks sulfur.
The disulfide bond breaks to expel thiolate.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Sulfur transfer installs the thio substituent.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Protonation gives the neutral alpha-thio carbonyl product.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Workup furnishes the neutral sulfide product.

templates.generic_notes: Base generates a sulfur ylide, which adds to a carbonyl and cyclizes to an epoxide.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Base forms the sulfur ylide.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The sulfur ylide is generated in situ.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The ylide carbon attacks the carbonyl carbon.
The carbonyl pi bond shifts to oxygen.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Addition produces the betaine intermediate.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Intramolecular closure forms the epoxide.
Sulfur leaves as the neutral byproduct.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Ring closure yields the epoxide.

templates.generic_notes: One hydroxyl is protonated and lost as water, then a 1,2-shift gives a carbonyl compound.

electron_pushes_generic.description: One hydroxyl group is protonated.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Protonation activates one alcohol as a leaving group.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Water leaves to generate a cationic center.
A 1,2-shift migrates to stabilize the cation and create an oxonium/carbonyl framework.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Loss of water is coupled to the 1,2-migration.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Deprotonation gives the neutral carbonyl product.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Deprotonation furnishes the rearranged ketone or aldehyde.

templates.generic_notes: The alcohol is protonated, water departs or is displaced, and chloride installs the C-Cl bond.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The alcohol is protonated.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Protonation activates the alcohol.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Water departs to generate the reactive cationic center or highly activated substrate.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Departure of water creates the substitution-ready intermediate.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Chloride attacks carbon to form the alkyl chloride.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Chloride captures the cationic intermediate.

templates.generic_notes: The ketone enolizes and the enol/enolate reacts with bromine to install bromine alpha to the carbonyl.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The ketone is converted to its enol or enolate form.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The reactive enol/enolate nucleophile is generated.

electron_pushes_generic.start_atom: enol pi bond or enolate alpha C
electron_pushes_generic.description: The alpha carbon attacks bromine.
The Br-Br bond breaks to bromide.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Electrophilic bromination occurs at the alpha position.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The carbonyl is restored after bromination.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The brominated intermediate returns to the carbonyl form.

generic_mechanism_steps.reaction_generic: alpha-brominated carbonyl precursor.base>>alpha-bromoketone.HBr |dbe:O-H or C-H adjustments|

electron_pushes_generic.description: Final deprotonation or tautomerization yields the neutral alpha-bromoketone.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Neutralization gives the isolated alpha-brominated ketone.

templates.generic_notes: A secondary amine condenses with formaldehyde to an iminium ion that is reduced by a mild hydride donor.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The amine attacks formaldehyde.
The carbonyl pi bond shifts to oxygen.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Initial addition gives the carbinolamine framework.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Proton transfers set up dehydration.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Proton transfer prepares the adduct for water loss.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Water is lost to form the iminium ion.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Dehydration forms the electrophilic iminium intermediate.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Hydride reduces the iminium carbon.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Hydride delivery forms the new N-methyl C-H bond.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Base deprotonates the ammonium product.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Deprotonation yields the neutral tertiary amine.

templates.generic_notes: A strong base removes the acidic C2 proton from the azolium salt to give the free carbene or a metal-associated carbene equivalent.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The base deprotonates the azolium C-H bond.
The bond electrons remain on carbon to generate the carbene.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The base removes the acidic proton adjacent to the cationic nitrogens, giving the carbene center.

templates.generic_notes: An alkoxide performs an SN2 substitution on a primary sulfonate ester to form a new C-O bond.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The alkoxide attacks the primary carbon.
The C-O bond to the sulfonate breaks.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The alkoxide attacks carbon and displaces the sulfonate leaving group.

templates.label_exact: Azide substitution on activated alcohol derivative
current_state_generic: activated alcohol derivative such as cyclic sulfate or sulfonate
templates.generic_notes: Azide displaces an activated leaving group in an SN2-type step to install N3.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Azide attacks carbon.
The leaving group departs.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Azide attacks the electrophilic carbon and expels the leaving group.

templates.generic_notes: The carbonyl compound is converted to an enolate/enol, which is trapped at oxygen by a methyl electrophile.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Base removes the alpha proton.
The electrons delocalize into the enolate.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Base generates the enolate or related oxygen-centered resonance form.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Oxygen attacks the methyl group.
The leaving group departs.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The enolate oxygen attacks the methyl electrophile to form the enol ether.

templates.label_exact: Phosphonium salt formation from alkyl halide and phosphine
templates.generic_notes: The phosphine lone pair attacks the alkyl halide in an SN2 step to form the phosphonium salt precursor to a Wittig reagent.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The phosphine attacks carbon.
The carbon-halogen bond breaks.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Phosphine attacks the primary carbon and the halide departs.

templates.generic_notes: The alkene is protonated to the more stable carbocation and bromide captures the cation.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The alkene attacks the proton.
The H-Br bond breaks to bromide.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The alkene pi bond is protonated to form the carbocation.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Bromide attacks the carbocation.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Bromide attacks the carbocation to form C-Br.

templates.generic_notes: The alkene is protonated and iodide captures the carbocation.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The alkene takes the proton.
The H-I bond breaks to iodide.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Protonation of the alkene generates the carbocation.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Iodide forms the C-I bond.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Iodide attacks the cationic carbon.

templates.generic_notes: The epoxide oxygen is protonated and halide opens the strained three-membered ring.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The epoxide oxygen is protonated.
The hydrogen halide bond breaks.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Protonation activates the epoxide toward ring opening.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Halide attacks the activated carbon.
The C-O bond breaks to open the ring.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Halide attacks and opens the epoxide ring.

templates.generic_notes: An electrophilic bromine species adds to the arene, giving a sigma complex that then loses a proton to restore aromaticity.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Activation makes bromine more electrophilic.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The bromine source is polarized or activated.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The ring forms the C-Br bond.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The aromatic ring attacks electrophilic bromine.

electron_pushes_generic.description: A base removes the proton to rearomatize.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Deprotonation restores aromaticity.

templates.generic_notes: Cyanide adds to the carbonyl and the resulting alkoxide is protonated.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Cyanide attacks the carbonyl carbon.
The pi bond shifts to oxygen.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Cyanide attacks the carbonyl carbon.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The alkoxide is protonated.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Protonation of the alkoxide gives the cyanohydrin.

templates.generic_notes: Cyanide adds at the beta position of an enone, generating an enolate that is then protonated.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Cyanide adds in a 1,4-fashion.
The electrons shift to the carbonyl oxygen.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Cyanide attacks the beta carbon of the conjugated system.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The intermediate is protonated.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Protonation yields the neutral product.

templates._correction: CHEM-003: Removed step 2 (resonance interconversion, not a real mechanistic step). Updated suitable_step_count to 2. Steps renumbered.

templates.label_exact: Conjugate hydrogen halide addition to enone
templates.generic_notes: Protonation and halide capture across the conjugated system gives overall 1,4-addition of HX.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The enone is protonated.
Halide is released.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The conjugated system is protonated to a cationic intermediate.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Halide forms the C-X bond.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Halide attacks at the beta position to give the conjugate-addition product.

templates.label_exact: Selective 1,2-reduction of enal to allylic alcohol
templates.generic_notes: Hydride adds to the aldehyde carbonyl and the alkoxide is protonated without reducing the alkene.

electron_pushes_generic.description: Hydride adds to the aldehyde carbon.
The carbonyl pi bond shifts to oxygen.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: Hydride attacks the carbonyl carbon of the enal.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The alkoxide is protonated.

generic_mechanism_steps.note: The alkoxide is protonated to give the allylic alcohol.

templates.generic_notes: The organometallic reagent adds to the carbonyl carbon and aqueous workup gives the alcohol.

electron_pushes_generic.description: The organometallic carbon attacks the carbonyl.
